decisions.reason: Changing the fiat on-ramp provider to Transak does not change the Brevo transactional-email provider or delivery behavior.
The provider choice for the fiat path does not alter SIWE authentication for wallet-based minting and NFT transfers.
Selecting Transak does not change magic-link authentication or the defined email-authenticated dashboard access.
The fiat on-ramp provider decision has no necessary effect on the badge set, icons, or presentation.
The source changes only the fiat on-ramp provider and does not modify the $10 automatic referral commission.
The Transak selection does not change referral-ticket recipients or Small and Big Block ticket quantities.
The fiat provider switch does not change ticket allocation for mints made without a referral code.
Choosing Transak as the fiat on-ramp does not change the requirement to deploy the smart-contract system on Base.
The payment-provider decision does not alter Chainlink VRF winner selection.
The source does not change any NFT metadata counters or permanent-badge visibility.
Selecting Transak does not change unauthenticated access to leaderboards or prize-pool values.
The fiat on-ramp provider switch does not affect secondary royalty enforcement, pool funding, or ticket creation rules.
